title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Snowdonia grid point, 6-11 September 2016-2025
claims: The requested grid point at 53.1045 N, 3.9835 W returns an elevation of 742 m (a high moorland grid point above the Snowdonia valleys).
For 6-11 September 2016-2025 (60 day-samples), daily high temperatures ranged from 7.7 to 22.8 °C with a median of 12.6 °C.
Daily low temperatures ranged from 3.3 to 15.1 °C with a median of 7.5 °C.
41 of 60 days recorded at least 1 mm of precipitation; 22 of 60 recorded at least 5 mm; single-day maximum 23.3 mm; mean daily precipitation 5.3 mm.
These are modelled grid-point values at high elevation, not measurements on camp or aid sites; valley lows and coastal sections run milder and drier than this point.

verification.checkedVia: PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod 读取 Open-Meteo archive API JSON，按 9 月 6–11 日过滤样本并重算 min/median/max 与降水计数
